# Univue Consultants ApS

> Univue Consultants simplifies international property investment by connecting clients with the right properties and coordinating the financial, legal and regulatory support needed to navigate cross-border acquisitions with confidence.

Univue Consultants ApS is a Danish-registered international cross-border advisory firm (CVR: 43834665) headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with partner networks and operational representations in Dubai (UAE), Bangalore (India), and Singapore (Southeast Asia).

## Strategic Corridors

- [United Arab Emirates (UAE)](https://univueconsultants.com/uae): Strategic off-plan and luxury property acquisitions across Dubai (Downtown, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Hills Estate), Abu Dhabi (Saadiyat Cultural District, Yas Island), and Ras Al Khaimah (Al Marjan Island / Wynn Integrated Resort). Highlights: 0% personal tax, 6-10% rental yields, 10-year UAE Golden Visa eligibility on acquisitions of 2,000,000 AED ($545k+) or higher.
- [India Expansion](https://univueconsultants.com/india): Turnkey corporate market entry, Grade-A commercial tech office setup, FDI regulatory compliance, and entity structuring in Bangalore (Asia's Silicon Valley), Gurgaon / Delhi NCR (Cyber City), and Mumbai (BKC).
- [Southeast Asia](https://univueconsultants.com/southeast-asia): Wealth management, Section 13O / 13U family office structures in Singapore, prime luxury residential in Bangkok, and cross-border Asian trade corridors.

## Core Advisory Services

- [Advisory Services](https://univueconsultants.com/services):
  - **Off-Plan Property Sourcing**: Priority allocations and pre-launch pricing with leading master developers: Emaar, Sobha Realty, DAMAC, Binghatti, Azizi, Wasl, Aldar, DLF, Prestige Group.
  - **Cross-Border Portfolio Positioning**: Currency diversification (USD-pegged hard assets), inflation hedging, and yield optimization.
  - **Transaction & Escrow Legal Coordination**: DLD title deed registration, Power of Attorney (PoA) remote purchases, and escrow account verification.
  - **India Operational Entry**: Commercial lease structuring, talent recruitment advisory, and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) compliance.
  - **Golden Visa & Free Zone Incorporation**: Turnkey residency facilitation and business registration in DIFC, DMCC, and ADGM.
